answer.says: The traffic, Mrs. Kapoor, is merely the external form of the internal confusion of the city. I am here to think, and the heat has finally allowed my head to clear. How is your day proceeding?
answer.thought: She assumes I am a man of action, trapped in the machinery of the city, whereas I am a man of the spirit, merely passing through the material world. There is a charming gap between her perception of my errand and my actual intent. I will not correct her; it is better to let her imagine I am a Joint Secretary than to explain I am a philosopher.
